sql.propToolProduct.getAllForCompany: select p.id, p.product_name, p.company_id, p.archived, p.interest_rate, p.term_length, p.dealer_fee, p.active from props.product p where p.company_id = :companyId and p.archived is not true order by p.product_name
sql.propToolProduct.insert: insert into props.product(product_name, company_id, term_length, interest_rate, dealer_fee, active, created_by_id) values (:productName, :companyId, :termLength, :interestRate, :dealerFee, :active, :createdById)
sql.propToolProduct.update: update props.product set product_name = :productName, term_length = :termLength, interest_rate = :interestRate, dealer_fee = :dealerFee, active = :active, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.propToolProduct.delete: update props.product set archived = true, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now() where id = :id
